items.title: Carry shared content into the Contact draft
items.why: The share receiver generates subject/body query parameters, but Contact only reads topic and discards both draft fields.
items.recipe: Apply a bounded plain-text draft to empty subject/message fields; preserve restored drafts and topic semantics. Reuse existing form and submission safeguards.
items.acceptance: A real share-to-contact click preserves Unicode title, text and URL as editable plain text; existing topic, blank and restored-form paths remain correct.
items.userOutcome: Visitors can send shared information without reconstructing a lost message.
items.stageRationale: Repair reproduced existing journeys before adding new breadth.

items.title: Count one page rating during its cooldown
items.why: The reaction click handler neither checks the cooldown nor guards pending requests. Rapid real clicks produce duplicate inserts; replay saves a stale whole-store snapshot.
items.recipe: Guard reaction admission synchronously, keep pending payload until acknowledged, and merge replay acknowledgements against current entries without overwriting newer ratings.
items.acceptance: Rapid clicks and reopening cannot post twice; denied storage still has an in-memory guard; failed requests retry once on revisit; replay completion preserves a newer rating and other page entries.
items.userOutcome: Visitors can give one reliable reaction without inflating the feedback used to improve the site.
items.stageRationale: Repair reproduced existing journeys before adding new breadth.
